ios._tunnelBundleIdNote: EXPLICIT AND LOCKED, never derived. gen-ios.py used to derive <bundleId>.tunnel; the shipped extension is .redsocket and RostamVPNApp pins saved NEVPNManager profiles to it. branding._taglineNote: 2026-10-27 owner: the brand is Rostam Mobile Security, not a VPN company. Replaced "Your Digital Guardian", which the website carried in 38 locales and gen-ios.py draws under the connect dial. The product NAME stays RostamVPN everywhere a store or a search engine reads it; this is the descriptor beneath it.
branding._provenanceNote: The second footer line under the connect dial, below the tagline. iOS ONLY today: RostamVPNApp.taglineView hardcoded it as a shared literal, so every brand printed rostam's provenance. Absent means the line is not drawn at all -- the same rule legal.contactEmail follows, because a claim about who made the app is worse wrong than missing. ⚠️ Emitted only by gen-ios.py; gen-branding.py does not read it and Android's footer still carries the literal. Same one-sided shape theme.warning had before it was added to gen-ios.py -- if Android ever brands its footer, read this key there too rather than adding a second one.
branding._warningNote: The 'running low' colour, and a brand role rather than a literal because it was #D7A23E hardcoded in three shared files: rostam's gold, rendered by all five brands. It cannot simply be `danger`, which is already per-brand: low and used-up must read as different states, and collapsing them loses the warning. redvpn takes an amber rather than a red for the same reason.

features._protectionNameNote: 2026-10-27 owner: RostamVPN gets Protect Mode, the same feature as RedVPN (BuildConfig.PROTECTION_NAME gates every Protect Mode path; no brand ifs). Plain descriptive name; never RedShield (a registered mark elsewhere).
features._throttleHardStopNote: 2026-10-27: the bundled boot config is a FALLBACK, and its throttle block had drifted. It said hard_stop false, so a fresh install slowed to 2 Mbps for the window between first launch and its first successful OTA fetch, then switched to stopping once the real config landed. The served config (gen2 v57) says hard_stop true, and the owner's decision is that there is no 2 Mbps tier at all -- three free days, then pay. Patched per brand by the boot config generator because src/main/assets/default-config.json is shared with redvpn and goglobe, which are not changing. Absent = leave the bundled value alone.
features._healthProbeUrlNote: 2026-10-27 owner: the tunnel-health probe on RostamVPN's own domain. It was https://ip-geo.example.com/ for every brand, so a RedVPN-owned hostname was compiled into the RostamVPN binary (ConfigManager.HealthConfig.DEFAULT and the bundled boot config) -- a brand link readable with `strings` even though the OTA config pointed elsewhere. Served by nginx on the rostamvpn-api site; the OTA gen2 config was republished as v57 with the same value. Absent = the shared worker, which is still what the other brands use.
features._protectionApiBaseNote: 2026-10-27: the Protect Mode API (score, scan, profiles, geo) on RostamVPN's own domain; same backend as vpn.red, X-App-Key rostam. Absent = https://vpn.red (RedVPN).

site._plansNote: USD list prices shown on the website, and they must match what the stores actually charge. The site advertised weekly 1.05, monthly 1.99, quarterly 4.99 and yearly 12.99 while Play and the App Store sold monthly 3.99 and yearly 39.99: a visitor read one number and was billed another, which is a refund generator and a Play misrepresentation exposure. Only the two periods the stores actually sell are listed. Change these together with the stores, never alone.
